title: Primordial Paradox bullet pattern recipes
description: A bullet pattern is data, not code: one emitter in pp_dodge_recipe.gml interprets these frames. Every frame is one spawn group, so a fight is tuned by editing numbers. Simulation rules (terminating inside the arena step cap, never spawning inside the exclusion radius, never exceeding max_concurrent) are proven by tools/check_data.py. Bounds mirror the constants in that file; tests/test_schemas.py compares them.

origin.description: A named edge, or an explicit point in the 256 by 240 frame.

wobble.description: Sideways drift. amp 0 means the bullet travels straight.

frame.description: One spawn group at step at, repeated count times with delay steps between each.

at.description: Step inside the pattern when the first bullet spawns.

spread.description: Degrees fanned around angle. 0 is a single line.

angle.description: GameMaker direction: 0 is right, 90 is down.

size.description: Bullet sprite edge in pixels. 8 is the normal bullet, 16 is the big one.

delay.description: Steps between the bullets of one count.

jitter_angle.description: Random degrees added per bullet, seeded so a fight replays the same.

shape.description: The family the emitter builds the group shape from.

length.description: Steps the pattern runs for, and the arena cap.

aim.description: fixed uses angle as given, at_marker turns the group toward the player marker.

max_concurrent.description: Bullets alive at once allowed before the emitter waits.
